title: BananaOS layout theme
description: A BananaOS theme file. A theme with a "screens" member is a layout theme and draws the whole menu itself; a theme without one is a colour theme over the Pixel look and only uses the colour/font/icon/sound keys. Any property may be a literal, an =expression or a {template} string. // and /* */ comments and trailing commas are allowed in the file the engine reads. See docs/THEMES.md and /usr/share/banana/themes/README.txt.

name.description: The theme's name, shown in Settings > Display & sound > Theme. Falls back to the file name.

author.description: The theme's author. Shown nowhere yet.

debug.description: true: theme errors are also drawn in red on the top screen, not only logged.

base.description: The palette the theme starts from (the Settings screen's look). Defaults to "dark".

accent.description: The selection, the logo and the boot banana colour: one of Banana's named accents, a colour (its lighter/darker/band/low shades are worked out), or all five shades.

anyOf.description: Each of the five accent shades given explicitly.

colors.description: The palette's colours by name (screenBg, ink, muted, edge, navy, panelBody, chipBand, slotOn, onPick, ...); the ones not named keep the base palette's. See system/rootfs/usr/share/banana/themes/README.txt.

font.description: The default font of text elements. A built-in name (pixel, pixel-medium, inter, inter-medium, inter-semibold, inter-bold) or a name given in "fonts".

vars.description: Named values usable in any expression ("=bg", "=hi + '80'").

components.description: Reusable elements, instanced with "use": "<name>" and parameterised with "with".

input.description: What the buttons do, per view. The defaults are the Carts theme's.

hints.description: The buttons shown by a "hints" list, per view: each entry is [key, label] or { "key", "label" }.

screens.description: The menu's screens. Each is { "top": [...], "bottom": [...] } (an array of elements, or a single element). "launch" is optional: the library's screens are used if it is missing. "all" is drawn over every view (a status bar).

fonts.description: The theme's own fonts (TTF, relative to the theme's JSON). "regular" and "medium" replace the menu's text and its titles; any name is usable from a text element's "font".

icons.description: A system's icon (PNG, about 128x128), by the system's id (nds, gba, gbc, gb, snes, nes, megadrive, n64, psx, pico-8, ports, ...).

sounds.description: The menu's sounds (WAV, relative to the theme's JSON), by name: scroll, select, back, fav, ready, insert. "off" for none.

logo.description: The logo at the top of the bottom screen (fitted into its box), relative to the theme's JSON.

prop.description: A leaf property: a literal number/string/boolean, an =expression, or a {template} string (expressions and templates are just strings).

value.description: Any property value: a number, string or boolean (including the =expression and {template} string forms), an array (of colour stops, radii, ...), or an object.

color.description: A colour: #rgb, #rgba, #rrggbb, #rrggbbaa, rgb(...), rgba(...), hsl(...), transparent or a few names, an =expression, or a {template}.

anchor.description: Which point of the element x/y places: "center", "top right", "bottom", "left"... (a combination of top/middle/bottom/left/center/right), or use ax/ay 0..1.

gradient.description: A linear gradient across the box (CSS angles: 180 runs top to bottom).

angle.description: The gradient's angle in degrees. Default 180.

stops.description: The colour stops, in order: a colour, optionally with a position ("#123 40%").

radius.description: A corner radius: a number, "50%" for a pill/circle, or [top-left, top-right, bottom-right, bottom-left].

shadow.description: A drop shadow under a box or text.

color.description: The shadow's colour; fully transparent means no shadow.

state.description: Properties that replace the element's own while "when" holds; the last matching state wins.

when.description: An expression that must be true for this state to apply.

smooth.description: Ease values towards their targets instead of jumping: one number (for x, y, w, h, opacity, scale), or { "x": ms, "scale": ms, ... } time constants per property.

x.description: Time constant for x, in ms.

y.description: Time constant for y, in ms.

w.description: Time constant for w, in ms.

h.description: Time constant for h, in ms.

opacity.description: Time constant for opacity, in ms.

scale.description: Time constant for scale, in ms.

element.description: An element: rect, text, image, group or list, chosen by "type" or inferred (a group if it has "children", text if "text", an image if "src", a list if "source", else a rect). An array of elements is a group of them. Unknown members are ignored, so a theme may carry newer keys.

type.description: The element's kind. Inferred from its other members when absent.

id.description: A name for the element (for the error messages).

x.description: Left position in the parent, in units or "50%" of it.

y.description: Top position in the parent, in units or "50%" of it.

w.description: Width in the parent. A rect or group without w/h fills its parent; text is as big as its lines.

h.description: Height in the parent. A rect or group without w/h fills its parent; text is as big as its lines.

right.description: Distance from the parent's right edge (with x and no w: stretches).

bottom.description: Distance from the parent's bottom edge (with y and no h: stretches).

scale.description: Grows or shrinks the element and its children about its anchor. Default 1.

opacity.description: 0..1, multiplied into the element and its children. Default 1.

visible.description: false: not drawn, nor its children.

if.description: false: not drawn, nor its children.

clip.description: true: children are cut to the element's box.

states.description: Property overrides while a condition holds.

onTap.description: A button the element acts as when tapped: "a", "b", "left", ...

layout.description: A group's layout: place its children one after another along a row or a column.

anyOf.description: An =expression or {template} that yields one of the values above.

gap.description: The space between laid-out children or list items.

justify.description: A row/column's alignment along its direction.

anyOf.description: An =expression or {template} that yields one of the values above.

align.description: Text alignment within w (left/center/right), or a row/column's alignment across its direction (start/center/end).

anyOf.description: An =expression or {template} that yields one of the values above.
An =expression or {template} that yields one of the values above.

fill.description: A rect or group's fill colour.

color.description: A rect's fill or a text's colour.

borderColor.description: The border's colour when "border" is a width.

font.description: The text's font: a built-in name or one from "fonts".

upper.description: true: the text is drawn in capitals.

wrap.description: true: the text wraps within w.

maxLines.description: The most lines a wrapped text may take.

ellipsis.description: A line longer than w ends in ... (default on).

src.description: An image's source: a hook ("{game.art}"), a file next to the theme's JSON, or a full path.

fallback.description: Another source to use when src is empty or doesn't load.

fit.description: How the picture fits its box.

anyOf.description: An =expression or {template} that yields one of the values above.

crop.description: A pre-fit crop of a DS picture.

anyOf.description: An =expression or {template} that yields one of the values above.

tint.description: A colour multiplied into the picture.

placeholder.description: A colour shown while the picture loads or when there is nothing.

anyOf.description: An =expression or {template} that yields one of the values above.
An =expression or {template} that yields one of the values above.

columns.description: A grid list's number of columns.

stepX.description: The horizontal distance between list items (default itemW + gap).

stepY.description: The vertical distance between list items (default itemH + gap).

anyOf.description: An =expression or {template} that yields one of the values above.

loop.description: true: the list wraps around (with behavior.wrap for the buttons).

flow.description: true: each item is as wide (row) or high (column) as its own content (hint chips).

range.description: A free list draws this far from the selection (default 8).

count.description: The number of items of a "range" list.

selectedOnTop.description: true (default): the selected item is drawn last, over its neighbours.

elementList.description: One element or an array of elements (an array is a group of them).

screen.description: One view's screens: an element or an array of elements each (top is the screen; bottom is unused on the one-panel Retroid Pocket Classic).

inputMap.description: What the buttons do in a view.

buttonAction.description: prev, next, prev:5 (move N), first, last, open, back, fav, resume, prevSystem, nextSystem, or none. START (Settings) and SELECT (search) stay Banana's.

key.description: The button's name (A, B, X, Y, ...).

launchMs.description: How long the launch view lasts before the game starts, in ms.

settleMs.description: How long the menu keeps redrawing after a move or a view change, for the theme's animations.

scrollMs.description: The list scroll's easing time constant, in ms.

fps.description: The redraw rate for a theme that reads "time", 1..60.

wrap.description: true: the buttons wrap the selection around the ends.

extraHints.description: true: Banana's own hints (SELECT Search, ...) are added to the theme's.

cues.description: The theme's sounds played during the launch view at these ms (insert, ...).

background.description: Pictures behind the screen and its dot pattern.

top.description: The top screen's background picture (PNG/JPEG, scaled to fill).

bottom.description: The bottom screen's background picture (PNG/JPEG, scaled to fill).

dither.description: false: the screens' dot pattern is off.
